title: Timber Fire Air Operations (B-Roll)
description: Air resources conduct suppression operations during the Timber Fire, Aug. 8-10, 2026.  The Timber Fire ignited Aug. 8, 2026, in the hills east of Highway 1 near Big Sur and Loma Vista on the Los Padres National Forest. The wildfire is being managed by California Incident Management Team 1 along with federal, state and local agencies working to directly suppress the fire to protect nearby homes and build containment lines. (Forest Service video by Andrew Kenner)
